cadence.final_policy: epoch ends before the 5M cadence point; the final checkpoint replaces it and the receipt says so

data.packing: one complete example per row; no boundary crossing

limits.sizing: floor peak + 1 GiB from the stage-2a cgroup peak 15,032,385,536 B; 16g minimum enforced by the launcher

recipe.gradient_checkpointing_note: exact recomputation of each block's forward; the S59 smoke measured step-1 loss 0.228619 against 0.228619 ungathered, i.e. equal within 1e-8, not bit-identical (different GEMM shapes)
recipe.lr_basis: registered stage-2b lr screen set {3e-6, 1e-5}; the full run uses the rate with the lower held-out solution CE
recipe.optimizer: Adam8bit block 256, int8 first moment, bf16 second moment, stochastic weight rounding
recipe.sft_logits_gather_note: the LM head emits logits only at supervised positions; masked positions contribute no loss or gradient. The S59 smoke measured step-1 loss 0.22861921042 (gathered) against 0.22861921787 (ungathered), a 7.5e-9 absolute difference from the GEMM shape, not bit-identity

student.note: post-trained chat checkpoint, not the Base model
